name: io.github.M2M-Sentinel/m2m-sentinel-sdk
title: M2M Sentinel
description: Base bytecode capability observations, proxy resolution, gas, DEX, and transfer telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: M2M_SENTINEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional M2M Sentinel API key for prepaid access.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Optional M2M Sentinel API key for prepaid access.

headers.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
headers.description: Optional x402 v2 payment signature when retrying a payable tool call.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Optional M2M Sentinel API key for prepaid access.

tools.name: m2m_audit_contract
tools.description: Inspect static bytecode capabilities (e.g. mint, pause, blacklist, upgradeability slots), common proxy target resolution, and coverage index for a single Base contract address. Factual capability observation only, not a safety or exploitability guarantee. Distinguishable from m2m_get_service_status (infrastructure health) and legacy score-only endpoints.

address.description: Base contract address (0x-prefixed 40-hex string, chainId 8453) to inspect.

tools.name: m2m_get_gas_metrics
tools.description: Fetch Base network gas fee metrics (standard, fast, instant in gwei) and transaction execution recommendations. Sourced for Base Mainnet execution timing; does not inspect contract code or fetch token/DEX pricing.

tools.name: m2m_get_token_price
tools.description: Fetch Base DEX liquidity-weighted spot price in USD, contract address, decimals, and pool source for a single allowlisted token symbol (e.g. USDC, WETH, AERO). Does not return historical price series; contrast with m2m_get_dex_liquidity which returns pool reserve depth rather than asset spot prices.

symbol.description: Allowlisted token symbol on Base (e.g. USDC, WETH, AERO). Lookups are case-insensitive single symbols.

tools.name: m2m_get_dex_liquidity
tools.description: Fetch real-time aggregate pool reserve, depth, and volume metrics across tracked Base DEX liquidity pools. Evaluates overall tracked pool liquidity health (aggregate tracked-pool metrics; does not filter by individual trading pair). Contrast with m2m_get_token_price which observes token spot prices.

tools.name: m2m_get_whale_signals
tools.description: Fetch tracked recent high-value ERC-20 transfer and concentration signals on Base (returns up to 50 recent signals) with transaction hash, transfer addresses, and value provenance. Observes large on-chain transfer events without query parameter limits; does not inspect contract bytecode or query DEX pricing.

tools.name: m2m_get_service_status
tools.description: Fetch operational status, upstream Base RPC quorum health, indexer state, and persistence availability for M2M Sentinel infrastructure. Does not return blockchain or market telemetry.
